nonblocking: Validate --count as a positive integer and decide whether --count > number of watched names is a usage error or a timeout-only condition; the plan currently states the quorum semantics but not this edge case.
Update watch usage/help and JSON docs when adding --count so existing consumers can rely on unchanged --any/--all output and only count mode adds required_count/done_count.
interface_changes: Clarify and fix the team quorum predicate interface before implementation: next-plan-codex shows `--field status --value success`, but `result_session --field` currently runs the argument as a jq expression against the raw result body, so the result-session-compatible form is `.status`, not bare `status` (skills/tmux-agent-tools/scripts/agent-tmux:3768-3773; .workflow/tier1-issue-266/next-plan-codex.md:66,74). Either make team quorum intentionally use the existing wait-required simple field style (`status`, `verdict.status`) or require jq expressions and update the examples/self-tests to `.status`.

If team quorum claims to reuse stored team-state result paths, implement it by reading/validating the row `result_path` directly or by factoring a path-based result reader. Current `result --json <name>` reads `$(agent_root_dir)/$name/result.json` and does not accept the stored path, while team state explicitly preserves `result_path` for workers (skills/tmux-agent-tools/scripts/agent-tmux:5377-5411,3679-3684,5575-5592; .workflow/tier1-issue-266/next-plan.md:13).

For watch --count, parse an explicit count mode instead of relying on the default `mode=any`: --count must reject any later/earlier --any or --all in the same invocation, then compute `done_count` from the existing `done_reason` map and break when `done_count >= required_count` (skills/tmux-agent-tools/scripts/agent-tmux:5128-5137,5175-5191).
notes: Re-review against current code approves the plan direction: Packet A is a clean extension of watch_session because done state is already tracked in done_reason and JSON assembly is centralized (skills/tmux-agent-tools/scripts/agent-tmux:5155-5208). Packet B is also viable without a new result schema because team results already aggregates present/valid/body from each worker result (skills/tmux-agent-tools/scripts/agent-tmux:5575-5600). A-before-B is reasonable but not a hard code dependency; B can be implemented independently, while A supplies the same count/quorum semantics and the smaller parser/test pattern first. Hidden collision risk is low because no existing quorum command is present and cmd_team dispatch is an exact case list (skills/tmux-agent-tools/scripts/agent-tmux:5433-5447), but the usage string must be updated when adding it. Self-check feasibility is acceptable if self_test_watch_count uses live tmux sessions or otherwise prevents missing sessions from being counted as immediate exited completions; current watch treats missing sessions as done by exit (skills/tmux-agent-tools/scripts/agent-tmux:5181-5184), so a purely fake-path test would pass for the wrong reason.
